mapper.select: INSERT INTO explore_feedback ( session_id, anonymous_id, mode, rank, anchor_music_id, target_music_id, prev_music_id, music_id, verdict, reason, listened_sec, skipped, user_email, bundle, rules) VALUES ( CAST(#{sessionId} AS uuid), CAST(#{anonymousId} AS uuid), #{mode}, #{rank}, #{anchorMusicId}, #{targetMusicId}, #{prevMusicId}, #{musicId}, #{verdict}, #{reason}, #{listenedSec}, #{skipped}, #{userEmail}, #{bundle}, #{rules}) ON CONFLICT (session_id, rank) DO UPDATE SET verdict = EXCLUDED.verdict, reason = EXCLUDED.reason, listened_sec = EXCLUDED.listened_sec, skipped = EXCLUDED.skipped, user_email = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.user_email, explore_feedback.user_email), anonymous_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.anonymous_id, explore_feedback.anonymous_id), updated_at = now() RETURNING id
